bundles.notes: The optical recovery of wax-cylinder recordings uses a laboratory and archival process unrelated to park administration, road construction, military service, or giant sequoias.
The archaeobotanical investigation centers on microscopy, controlled baking, contextual evidence, and cautious inference rather than a historical leader or infrastructure project.

pairDistinctness.notes: A reconstructs historic sound with optical technology; B interprets ancient food with microscopy and experimental archaeology. Their materials, methods, evidence, and conclusions are distinct.
